labeling_semantics: Candidates not explicitly assigned to relevant, acceptable_secondary, harmful_stale, or forbidden are treated as irrelevant by default. Explicit irrelevant arrays may remain empty.
claim_boundary: This manifest freezes human relevance labels before Personalized PageRank implementation or retrieval output. Labels define expected relevance under the synthetic corpus; they do not establish truth, authority, permission, or suitability for live prompt use.
